items.title: Frontier Says It’s Poised to Gain From Spirit’s Collapse
items.summary: Frontier is looking to absorb some of Spirit’s demand and expand in markets like Orlando, Fort Lauderdale, Dallas-Fort Worth, and Detroit — all of which are former Spirit strongholds.

items.summary: Priceline has been a savvy marketer over the years, and this ad campaign tease hits the right notes at a time when affordability concerns are a major trend.

items.title: Turkey’s Tourism Held Up in March Despite Sharp Drop in Gulf Travel
items.summary: Q2 will determine whether this is a temporary shock or a structural reset for one of Turkey’s most valuable visitor segments.

items.title: Dubai Strengthens Passenger Rights Rules to Rebuild Traveler Trust
items.summary: Dubai’s passenger rights framework means one regulator, one rulebook. The details around enforcement are still to come, though.

items.title: JetBlue and Rivals Race to Grab Spirit’s Routes and Customers
items.summary: Airlines are quickly adding new routes out of some of Spirit’s biggest cities, including Fort Lauderdale, Orlando, and Atlantic City.

items.title: Grab Takes Taxis Across the Singapore-Malaysia Border
items.summary: “Travel companion” Grab clearly isn’t ready to say goodbye at the border. With its cross-border taxi pilot, Grab is stretching the definition of “last mile” into an international one, keeping travelers in-app the entire way.

items.title: Why Agentic AI Is the Biggest Threat to Legacy Hotel Software Vendors
items.summary: Vivek Bhogaraju doesn’t follow AI hype. He tracks where capital moves, and right now it’s flowing toward agentic AI that is starting to dismantle legacy hospitality tech.
